identity.title: Falsification-Grade Experiment Registry & Research Dataset OS
identity.objective: Implement one local/offline deterministic experiment-control substrate that reuses existing dataset identities, freezes feature/label/sample/split/hypothesis/family/preregistration identities, enforces leakage-safe temporal partitions and sealed OOS evidence, retains every trial outcome, and persists bounded append-only tamper-evident metadata in an explicit caller-selected SQLite registry without strategy, cost-adjusted, paper, execution, live, credential, scheduler, Hermes, dashboard, or product-network authority.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: Karl explicitly authorized the attached one-shot WP170 XL package and its coherent same-risk capability. The exact 26-path scope includes the discovered narrow readiness-parser compatibility fix and the later full-suite-discovered historical source-scope guard compatibility fix, with focused regressions under prompt sections 6G and 8F, while consolidating product implementation into two source modules, six focused test modules, one contract, three immutable package artifacts, one focused CI integration, stable status/repo-truth reconciliation, two roadmap updates, and three mechanically required historical compatibility tests.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the WP170 branch. The experiment-control records, builders, split/lifecycle validation, explicit local SQLite registry, focused tests, contract, evidence artifacts, CI step, and repo-truth updates disappear without changing canonical PIT records, DatasetSnapshotReference semantics, analytical Parquet identity, WP169 acquisition, Nautilus replay, dependency pins, runtime network, credentials, strategy, paper, execution, or live behavior.
